user.title: Predictive Sleep
user.description:
Learns when each person goes to sleep and predicts their next bedtime, so the home can get ready ahead of time.

Predictive Sleep v{version} by Goobis
AI was used to help develop this integration.

household.title: Household sensors
household.description: Adds sensors for the whole home: when everyone's asleep, when someone's getting ready for bed, and tonight's earliest and latest bedtimes.

sources.title: {name}'s calendars
sources.description: Pick the calendars with things {name} needs to be up for, like work. No calendar? Leave this empty and bedtimes are learned from habit alone.

calendar.title: {calendar}
calendar.description: What does {name} use this calendar for?

signals.title: How do we know {name} is in bed?
signals.description: Pick a bed sensor, a sleep tracker, or both. Without either, use the In bed for the night switch: on going to bed, off on getting up.

data_description.in_bed_signals: A bed sensor for {name}'s side that turns on and off, or presence aimed at the bed. Not a number like bed pressure.
data_description.asleep_signals: Measured sleep, like Sleep as Android or Withings. Not a sleep focus or bedtime schedule.

habits.title: {name}'s usual routine
habits.description: Rough guesses are fine. These are learned from {name}'s real nights from here on.

data.free_bedtime: Usual bedtime on a night off
data.prep_minutes: Time from waking to starting work

habits_free.title: {name}'s usual routine
habits_free.description: Rough guesses are fine. These are learned from {name}'s real nights from here on.

unnamed.title: {calendar}
unnamed.description: Some events here won't say who they're for, like "Dentist".

data_description.unnamed: Guessing checks who leaves home around that time, and remembers the event and place for next time.

error.already_configured: This person is already set up. Pick someone else.
error.numeric_in_bed: This reads a number, not in bed or out of bed. Pick the sensor that turns on when someone's in bed.

abort.already_configured: This person is already set up.
abort.household_exists: Household sensors are already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This is already being set up.

calendars.description: Pick the calendars with things {name} needs to be up for, like work. No calendar? Leave this empty and bedtimes are learned from habit alone.

data.words: Words that mean an event counts

data_description.words: Not used for work calendars. Whole words, ignoring case: "work" matches "Work (Sam)" but not "Workout".

signals.title: Sleep signals

data_description.in_bed_signals: A bed sensor for {name}'s side that turns on and off, or presence aimed at the bed. Not a number like bed pressure.
data_description.asleep_signals: Measured sleep, like Sleep as Android or Withings. Not a sleep focus or bedtime schedule.
data_description.asleep_states: Only for trackers that report words instead of on/off.

signals.description: Without any, the In bed for the night switch does the job.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: Usual bedtime, sleep needed, get-ready and unwind times are learned automatically, so they aren't settings.

data.pause_states: Pause when it's in one of these states
data.notify_service: After each night, send a note to
data.use_sleep_debt: Go to bed earlier after short nights

data_description.pause_entities: For example a home-mode selector, so guest or vacation nights aren't learned.
data_description.notify_service: A phone. The note has a Forget button for nights that weren't normal.
data_description.use_sleep_debt: Short nights tend to lead to earlier bedtimes. Best after a few weeks of learning.

data.wind_down_minutes: Wind-down starts this long before bedtime
data.settle_minutes: In bed this long counts as going to sleep
data.wake_gap_minutes: Out of bed this long counts as awake
data.min_sleep_hours: Shortest sleep that counts as a night

forget_last_night.name: Forget last sleep
forget_last_night.description: Removes the most recently recorded sleep from learning, for one that was not typical.

entry_not_loaded.message: Pick a person's Predictive Sleep entry that is loaded.

missing_calendar.title: {name}: calendar not found
missing_calendar.description: Predictive Sleep can't find {calendars}. It may have been removed or renamed, so {name}'s predictions are using the last shifts it read. Choose the calendars again under Settings → Devices & services → Predictive Sleep → Configure → Calendars.
